# Zeeshan Traders

> Agricultural dealership located at Maqsood Chowk, District Layyah, Punjab, Pakistan. Serving farmers and traders with certified fertilizers, pesticides, seeds, animal feeds, cement, and grains.

## Main Resources
- [Home](https://zt-v2.sastishopping-store.workers.dev/): Storefront with product showcases, rates, and business information
- [Products](https://zt-v2.sastishopping-store.workers.dev/products): Catalogue of fertilizers, seeds, choker, wanda, cement, and grains
- [Categories](https://zt-v2.sastishopping-store.workers.dev/categories): Directory of all agricultural departments
- [Public API](https://zt-v2.sastishopping-store.workers.dev/api/v1/public/products): Public REST API endpoint for catalogue
- [Enquiry](https://zt-v2.sastishopping-store.workers.dev/enquiry): Order and rate inquiry form
- [Contact](https://zt-v2.sastishopping-store.workers.dev/contact): Location details, WhatsApp, and phone contacts
